Data Science Portfolio

    About
    Turning complex data into clear decisions
    
    
      
        
          
          
            Agu CharlesChibuike
            Data Scientist
            MSc Data ScienceUniversity of Nairobi
          
        
        
          
            I am a data scientist and analytics engineer with a focus on 
            longitudinal health data, business intelligence, and financial analytics. 
            My work spans the full pipeline — from raw sensor data and relational 
            databases to interactive dashboards and statistical modelling.
          
          
            My MSc capstone investigates how training behaviour, sleep architecture, 
            and recovery physiology interact across a cohort of 14 runners over four 
            years — combining Garmin wearable data with mixed-effects modelling in R.
          
          
            Outside academia I build portfolio-grade analytics engineering projects 
            using SQL, PostgreSQL, and Power BI, targeting roles in data analytics 
            and analytics engineering.

    Projects
    Selected work
    
    

      
      
        01 / MSc CAPSTONE
        Nairobi Runners — Training, Sleep & Recovery
        
          Longitudinal analysis of 14 runners across 4 years. 
          Mixed-effects modelling, sleep staging, VO₂max trajectories, 
          and overtraining detection using Garmin wearable data.
        
        
          R
          Shiny

          Plotly
          Quarto

        01 / INTERACTIVE
        Live Dashboard — Nairobi Runners

          individual athlete deep-dives, correlation matrices, 
          lag analysis, and training monotony tracking.
        
        
          Shiny
          bslib
          DT

        Open dashboard
      


      
        02 / ANALYTICS ENGINEERING
        Olist E-Commerce Analytics
        
          End-to-end analytics engineering on 100k+ Brazilian orders. 
          Star schema design, advanced SQL, cohort analysis,

        03 / ANALYTICS ENGINEERING
        Parking Enforcement Analytics
